audit_scope: Every Python LOC under baseline/pcmmad_receiver, tools/csc_native, system, and tests; generated/extracted/data surfaces excluded.

CODEX_OMEGA_BIBLE.md.role: theoretical maximum / immutable laws / Omega quality frame

UNIFIED_CODE_STANDARDS_DOCTRINE_v1.2.md.role: canonical Rahl-authored code standards / PDVER / code-level mandates

OMEGA_L1_NO_STUBS.basis: Law 1 / 0-Day Not Someday: no stubs, TODOs, placeholders, incomplete implementation framed as done.

OMEGA_L4_EVIDENCE_BOUNDARY.basis: Law 4 / Pedantic Verification: no unsupported confidence, no unread-gap language in load-bearing code comments/docs.

UCS_FAILURE_LOCALITY.basis: Failure locality: no silent failures, swallowed exceptions, or untraceable propagation.

UCS_TYPED_BOUNDARY.basis: Typed boundaries: avoid dict-smearing, stringly APIs, anonymous payload leakage across module seams.

UCS_SUBSTRATE_SOVEREIGNTY.basis: Substrate sovereignty: imports are material; heavy or brittle dependencies must be justified/lazy.

UCS_COGNITIVE_CONSERVATION.basis: Cognitive conservation: parameters <=4, file/function/nesting complexity within working-memory limits.

UCS_ERROR_VALUES.basis: Errors must be explicit/actionable; no broad catch without structured conversion or re-raise.

UCS_JSON_BOUNDARY.basis: Serialization formats explicit/versioned; centralize JSON boundaries.

UCS_COMMAND_BOUNDARY.basis: Execution boundaries must use hardened envelopes; no shell=True; no ad hoc subprocess output shapes.

UCS_STATE_DISCIPLINE.basis: Global state requires explicit lifecycle; prefer append-only/immutable state where feasible.

UCS_HARD_CODED_PATH.basis: Substrate sovereignty / boundary discipline: hardcoded machine paths are local truth leakage unless isolated in config.
